# Swift ground-truth fixtures for the React Native rewrite

Generated by the Swift app itself (DEBUG build, iPad simulator, GitHub Actions). All data is fictional: made-up names,
`example.invalid` mail, placeholder keychain values. No real user data and no secrets.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `swift-store-small.zip` | Seed profile `small` (300 track points). `live/` = store files copied while the app ran (with `-wal`/`-shm`), `closed/` = copied after termination, plus `seed-report.json`, `container.txt` |
| `user-defaults-small.plist` | UserDefaults export (the app container `Library/Preferences/io.omer.efb.plist` after termination (cfprefsd flushes it late: the live copy holds only `hasSeenOnboarding`; `defaults export` on the simulator returned an empty dict)) |
| `seed-report-small.json` | Paths, model counts, UserDefaults domain and keychain probe from the run |
| `app/tests/goldens/*.json` (outside this folder) | Scenario event logs (`kanaf-scenario-golden/1`), 8 files, one per `tools/flight-sim/scenarios/*.json` |

Full-size data (3,600 track points) is the `swift-store-fixtures` artifact of the "Swift fixtures and goldens" workflow.
Schema findings: `app/docs/swift-store-layout.md`.

## Regenerate

- Fixtures: run workflow `.github/workflows/fixtures.yml` (workflow_dispatch). It builds the DEBUG app and runs
  `tools/ci/make-fixtures.sh`, which launches with `-OpenEFBSeed full|small` (`efb-212/Services/Simulation/SeedDataHook.swift`).
  The layout doc comes from `tools/ci/swift-store-schema.py <dir>`.
- Goldens: the same workflow's `goldens` job runs `tools/ci/export-scenario-goldens.sh`, which flies each scenario through
  `efb-212Tests/Simulation/ScenarioGoldenExport.swift` (virtual clock, production pipeline, same path as
  `ScenarioFlightTests`) twice and fails unless both runs are byte-identical.

Ids are deterministic (`<kind>-0000-4000-8000-<n>`); dates are offsets from 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z.

## Known limits of the simulator run

- Keychain: the unsigned simulator build cannot use the keychain (`errSecMissingEntitlement`, -34018) for writes or
  queries, so no keychain fixture exists; `seed-report*.json` records the write results. The service name and account
  names come from the code (`quartermint.efb-212.faa-notam-api`, `client_id`, `client_secret`) and need a device check (D3).
- `seed-report-small.json` has the runner's container path replaced by `<container>`; the zip keeps the raw report.
